member.name: P:Goedel.Contacts.JsCalendarEntry.Sequence
member.summary: Initially zero, this MUST be incremented by one every time a change is made to the object, except if the change only modifies the participants property (see Section 4.4.6).

member.name: P:Goedel.Contacts.JsCalendarEntry.Method
member.summary: This is the iTIP [RFC5546] method, in lowercase. This MUST only be present if the JSCalendar object represents an iTIP scheduling message.

member.name: P:Goedel.Contacts.JsCalendarEntry.Title
member.summary: This is a short summary of the object.

member.name: P:Goedel.Contacts.JsCalendarEntry.Description
member.summary: This is a longer-form text description of the object. The content is formatted according to the descriptionContentType property.

member.name: P:Goedel.Contacts.JsCalendarEntry.DescriptionContentType
member.summary: This describes the media type [RFC6838] of the contents of the description property. Media types MUST be subtypes of type text and SHOULD be text/plain or text/html [MEDIATYPES]. They MAY include parameters, and the charset parameter value MUST be utf-8, if specified. Descriptions of type text/html MAY contain cid URLs [RFC2392] to reference links in the calendar object by use of the cid property of the Link object.

member.name: P:Goedel.Contacts.JsCalendarEntry.ShowWithoutTime
member.summary: This indicates that the time is not important to display to the user when rendering this calendar object. An example of this is an event that conceptually occurs all day or across multiple days, such as "New Year's Day" or "Italy Vacation". While the time component is important for free-busy calculations and checking for scheduling clashes, calendars may choose to omit displaying it and/or display the object separately to other objects to enhance the user's view of their schedule.

member.name: P:Goedel.Contacts.JsCalendarEntry.Locations
member.summary: This is a map of location ids to Location objects, representing locations associated with the object.

member.name: P:Goedel.Contacts.JsCalendarEntry.links
member.summary: This is a map of link ids to Link objects, representing external resources associated with the object.

member.name: P:Goedel.Contacts.JsCalendarEntry.Locale
member.summary: This is the language tag, as defined in [RFC5646], that best describes the locale used for the text in the calendar object, if known.

member.name: P:Goedel.Contacts.JsCalendarEntry.Keywords
member.summary: This is a set of keywords or tags that relate to the object. The set is represented as a map, with the keys being the keywords. The value for each key in the map MUST be true.

member.name: P:Goedel.Contacts.JsCalendarEntry.Categories
member.summary: This is a set of categories that relate to the calendar object. The set is represented as a map, with the keys being the categories specified as URIs. The value for each key in the map MUST be true.

member.name: P:Goedel.Contacts.JsCalendarEntry.Color
member.summary: This is a color clients MAY use when displaying this calendar object. The value is a color name taken from the set of names defined in Section 4.3 of CSS Color Module Level 3 [COLORS] or an RGB value in hexadecimal notation, as defined in Section 4.2.1 of CSS Color Module Level 3.

member.name: P:Goedel.Contacts.JsCalendarEntry.RecurrenceId
member.summary: If present, this JSCalendar object represents one occurrence of a recurring JSCalendar object. If present, the recurrenceRules and recurrenceOverrides properties MUST NOT be present.

member.name: P:Goedel.Contacts.JsCalendarEntry.RecurrenceIdTimeZone
member.summary: Identifies the time zone of the main JSCalendar object, of which this JSCalendar object is a recurrence instance. This property MUST be set if the recurrenceId property is set. It MUST NOT be set if the recurrenceId property is not set.

member.name: P:Goedel.Contacts.JsCalendarEntry.RecurrenceRules
member.summary: This defines a set of recurrence rules (repeating patterns) for recurring calendar objects. An Event recurs by applying the recurrence rules to the start date-time. A Task recurs by applying the recurrence rules to the start date-time, if defined; otherwise, it recurs by the due date-time, if defined. If the task defines neither a start nor due date-time, it MUST NOT define a recurrenceRules property.

member.name: P:Goedel.Contacts.JsCalendarEntry.ExcludedRecurrenceRules
member.summary: This defines a set of recurrence rules (repeating patterns) for date-times on which the object will not occur. The rules are interpreted the same as for the recurrenceRules property (see Section 4.3.3), with the exception that the initial date-time to which the rule is applied (the "start" date-time for events or the "start" or "due" date-time for tasks) is only considered part of the expansion if it matches the rule. The resulting set of date-times is then removed from those generated by the recurrenceRules property, as described in Section 4.3.

member.name: P:Goedel.Contacts.JsCalendarEntry.RecurrenceOverrides
member.summary: Maps recurrence ids (the date-time produced by the recurrence rule) to the overridden properties of the recurrence instance.

member.name: P:Goedel.Contacts.JsCalendarEntry.Excluded
member.summary: This defines if this object is an overridden, excluded instance of a recurring JSCalendar object (see Section 4.3.5). If this property value is true, this calendar object instance MUST be removed from the occurrence expansion. The absence of this property, or the presence of its default value as false, indicates that this instance MUST be included in the occurrence expansion.

member.name: P:Goedel.Contacts.JsCalendarEntry.Priority
member.summary: This specifies a priority for the calendar object. This may be used as part of scheduling systems to help resolve conflicts for a time period.

member.name: P:Goedel.Contacts.JsCalendarEntry.FreeBusyStatus
member.summary: This specifies how this calendar object should be treated when calculating free-busy state. This MUST be one of the following values, another value registered in the IANA "JSCalendar Enum Values" registry, or a vendor-specific value (see Section 3.3):

member.name: P:Goedel.Contacts.JsCalendarEntry.Privacy
member.summary: Calendar objects are normally collected together and may be shared with other users. The privacy property allows the object owner to indicate that it should not be shared or should only have the time information shared but the details withheld. Enforcement of the restrictions indicated by this property is up to the API via which this object is accessed.

member.name: P:Goedel.Contacts.JsCalendarEntry.ReplyTo
member.summary: This represents methods by which participants may submit their response to the organizer of the calendar object. The keys in the property value are the available methods and MUST only contain ASCII alphanumeric characters (A-Za-z0-9). The value is a URI for the method specified in the key. Future methods may be defined in future specifications and registered with IANA; a calendar client MUST ignore any method it does not understand but MUST preserve the method key and URI. This property MUST be omitted if no method is defined (rather than being specified as an empty object).

member.name: P:Goedel.Contacts.JsCalendarEntry.SentBy
member.summary: This is the email address in the "From" header of the email in which this calendar object was received. This is only relevant if the calendar object is received via iMIP or as an attachment to a message. If set, the value MUST be a valid addr-spec value as defined in Section 3.4.1 of [RFC5322].

member.name: P:Goedel.Contacts.JsCalendarEntry.Participants
member.summary: This is a map of participant ids to participants, describing their participation in the calendar object.

member.name: P:Goedel.Contacts.JsCalendarEntry.RequestStatus

member.name: P:Goedel.Contacts.JsCalendarEntry.UseDefaultAlerts
member.summary: If true, use the user's default alerts and ignore the value of the alerts property. Fetching user defaults is dependent on the API from which this JSCalendar object is being fetched and is not defined in this specification. If an implementation cannot determine the user's default alerts, or none are set, it MUST process the alerts property as if useDefaultAlerts is set to false.

member.name: P:Goedel.Contacts.JsCalendarEntry.Alerts
member.summary: This is a map of alert ids to Alert objects, representing alerts/reminders to display or send to the user for this calendar object.

member.name: P:Goedel.Contacts.JsCalendarEntry.Localizations
member.summary: A map where each key is a language tag [RFC5646], and the corresponding value is a set of patches to apply to the calendar object in order to localize it into that locale.

member.name: P:Goedel.Contacts.JsCalendarEntry.TimeZone
member.summary: This identifies the time zone the object is scheduled in or is null for floating time. This is either a name from the IANA Time Zone Database [TZDB] or the TimeZoneId of a custom time zone from the timeZones property (Section 4.7.2). If omitted, this MUST be presumed to be null (i.e., floating time).

member.name: P:Goedel.Contacts.Location.Type

member.name: P:Goedel.Contacts.Location.Name
member.summary: This is the human-readable name of the location.

member.name: P:Goedel.Contacts.Location.Description

member.name: P:Goedel.Contacts.Location.LocationTypes

member.name: P:Goedel.Contacts.Location.RelativeTo
member.summary: This specifies the relation between this location and the time of the JSCalendar object. This is primarily to allow events representing travel to specify the location of departure (at the start of the event) and location of arrival (at the end); this is particularly important if these locations are in different time zones, as a client may wish to highlight this information for the user.

member.name: P:Goedel.Contacts.Location.TimeZone

member.name: P:Goedel.Contacts.Location.Coordinates

member.name: P:Goedel.Contacts.Location.Link

member.name: P:Goedel.Contacts.Link.ContentType

member.name: P:Goedel.Contacts.Link.Size
member.summary: This is the size, in octets, of the resource when fully decoded (i.e., the number of octets in the file the user would download), if known. member.name: P:Goedel.Contacts.Link.Rel

member.name: P:Goedel.Contacts.Link.Title

member.name: T:Goedel.Contacts.Participant
member.summary: A Participant object has the following properties:

member.name: P:Goedel.Contacts.Participant.Type
member.summary: This specifies the type of this object. This MUST be Participant.

member.name: P:Goedel.Contacts.Participant.name
member.summary: This is the display name of the participant (e.g., "Joe Bloggs").

member.name: P:Goedel.Contacts.Participant.email
member.summary: This is the email address to use to contact the participant or, for example, match with an address book entry. If set, the value MUST be a valid addr-spec value as defined in Section 3.4.1 of [RFC5322].

member.name: P:Goedel.Contacts.Participant.description
member.summary: This is a plain-text description of this participant. For example, this may include more information about their role in the event or how best to contact them.

member.name: P:Goedel.Contacts.Participant.sendTo
member.summary: This represents methods by which the participant may receive the invitation and updates to the calendar object.

member.name: P:Goedel.Contacts.Participant.group
member.summary: a collection of people invited as a whole

member.name: P:Goedel.Contacts.Participant.location
member.summary: a physical location that needs to be scheduled, e.g., a conference room

member.name: P:Goedel.Contacts.Participant.resource
member.summary: a non-human resource other than a location, such as a projector

member.name: P:Goedel.Contacts.Participant.roles
member.summary: This is a set of roles that this participant fulfills. At least one role MUST be specified for the participant. The keys in the set MUST be one of the following values, another value registered in the IANA "JSCalendar Enum Values" registry, or a vendor-specific value (see Section 3.3):

member.name: P:Goedel.Contacts.Participant.locationId
member.summary: This is the location at which this participant is expected to be attending.

member.name: P:Goedel.Contacts.Participant.language
member.summary: This is the language tag, as defined in [RFC5646], that best describes the participant's preferred language, if known.

member.name: P:Goedel.Contacts.Participant.participationStatus
member.summary: This is the participation status, if any, of this participant.

member.name: P:Goedel.Contacts.Participant.participationComment
member.summary: This is a note from the participant to explain their participation status.

member.name: P:Goedel.Contacts.Participant.expectReply
member.summary: If true, the organizer is expecting the participant to notify them of their participation status.

member.name: P:Goedel.Contacts.Participant.scheduleAgent
member.summary: This is who is responsible for sending scheduling messages with this calendar object to the participant.

member.name: P:Goedel.Contacts.Participant.scheduleForceSend
member.summary: A client may set the property on a participant to true to request that the server send a scheduling message to the participant when it would not normally do so (e.g., if no significant change is made the object or the scheduleAgent is set to client). The property MUST NOT be stored in the JSCalendar object on the server or appear in a scheduling message.

member.name: P:Goedel.Contacts.Participant.scheduleSequence
member.summary: This is the sequence number of the last response from the participant. If defined, this MUST be a nonnegative integer.

member.name: P:Goedel.Contacts.Participant.scheduleStatus
member.summary: This is a list of status codes, returned from the processing of the most recent scheduling message sent to this participant. The status codes MUST be valid statcode values as defined in the ABNF in Section 3.8.8.3 of [RFC5545].

member.name: P:Goedel.Contacts.Participant.scheduleUpdated
member.summary: This is the timestamp for the most recent response from this participant.

member.name: P:Goedel.Contacts.Participant.sentBy
member.summary: This is the email address in the "From" header of the email that last updated this participant via iMIP. This SHOULD only be set if the email address is different to that in the mailto URI of this participant's imip method in the sendTo property (i.e., the response was received from a different address to that which the invitation was sent to). If set, the value MUST be a valid addr-spec value as defined in Section 3.4.1 of [RFC5322].

member.name: P:Goedel.Contacts.Participant.invitedBy
member.summary: This is the id of the participant who added this participant to the event/task, if known.

member.name: P:Goedel.Contacts.Participant.delegatedTo
member.summary: This is set of participant ids that this participant has delegated their participation to. Each key in the set MUST be the id of a participant. The value for each key in the map MUST be true. If there are no delegates, this MUST be omitted (rather than specified as an empty set).

member.name: P:Goedel.Contacts.Participant.delegatedFrom
member.summary: This is a set of participant ids that this participant is acting as a delegate for. Each key in the set MUST be the id of a participant. The value for each key in the map MUST be true. If there are no delegators, this MUST be omitted (rather than specified as an empty set).

member.name: P:Goedel.Contacts.Participant.memberOf
member.summary: This is a set of group participants that were invited to this calendar object, which caused this participant to be invited due to their membership in the group(s). Each key in the set MUST be the id of a participant. The value for each key in the map MUST be true. If there are no groups, this MUST be omitted (rather than specified as an empty set).

member.name: P:Goedel.Contacts.Participant.links
member.summary: This is a map of link ids to Link objects, representing external resources associated with this participant, for example, a vCard or image. If there are no links, this MUST be omitted (rather than specified as an empty set).

member.name: P:Goedel.Contacts.Participant.progress
member.summary: This represents the progress of the participant for this task. It MUST NOT be set if the participationStatus of this participant is any value other than accepted. See Section 5.2.5 for allowed values and semantics.

member.name: P:Goedel.Contacts.Participant.progressUpdated
member.summary: This specifies the date-time the progress property was last set on this participant. See Section 5.2.6 for allowed values and semantics.

member.name: P:Goedel.Contacts.Participant.percentComplete
member.summary: This represents the percent completion of the participant for this task. The property value MUST be a positive integer between 0 and 100.

member.name: P:Goedel.Contacts.RecurrenceRule.Type
member.summary: This specifies the type of this object. This MUST be RecurrenceRule.

member.name: P:Goedel.Contacts.RecurrenceRule.frequency
member.summary: This is the time span covered by each iteration of this recurrence rule (see Section 4.3.3.1 for full semantics).

member.name: P:Goedel.Contacts.RecurrenceRule.interval
member.summary: This is the interval of iteration periods at which the recurrence repeats. If included, it MUST be an integer >= 1.

member.name: P:Goedel.Contacts.RecurrenceRule.rscale
member.summary: This is the calendar system in which this recurrence rule operates, in lowercase. This MUST be either a CLDR-registered calendar system name [CLDR] or a vendor-specific value (see Section 3.3).

member.name: P:Goedel.Contacts.RecurrenceRule.skip
member.summary: This is the behavior to use when the expansion of the recurrence produces invalid dates. This property only has an effect if the frequency is "yearly" or "monthly". It MUST be one of the following values:

member.name: P:Goedel.Contacts.RecurrenceRule.firstDayOfWeek
member.summary: This is the day on which the week is considered to start, represented as a lowercase, abbreviated, and two-letter English day of the week. If included, it MUST be one of the following values:

member.name: P:Goedel.Contacts.RecurrenceRule.byDay
member.summary: These are days of the week on which to repeat.

member.name: P:Goedel.Contacts.RecurrenceRule.nthOfPeriod
member.summary: If present, rather than representing every occurrence of the weekday defined in the day property, it represents only a specific instance within the recurrence period. The value can be positive or negative but MUST NOT be zero. A negative integer means the nth-last occurrence within that period (i.e., -1 is the last occurrence, -2 the one before that, etc.).

member.name: P:Goedel.Contacts.RecurrenceRule.byMonthDay
member.summary: These are the days of the month on which to repeat. Valid values are between 1 and the maximum number of days any month may have in the calendar given by the rscale property and the negative values of these numbers. For example, in the Gregorian calendar, valid values are 1 to 31 and -31 to -1. Negative values offset from the end of the month. The array MUST have at least one entry if included.

member.name: P:Goedel.Contacts.RecurrenceRule.byMonth
member.summary: These are the months in which to repeat. Each entry is a string representation of a number, starting from "1" for the first month in the calendar (e.g., "1" means January with the Gregorian calendar), with an optional "L" suffix (see [RFC7529]) for leap months (this MUST be uppercase, e.g., "3L"). The array MUST have at least one entry if included.

member.name: P:Goedel.Contacts.RecurrenceRule.byYearDay
member.summary: These are the days of the year on which to repeat. Valid values are between 1 and the maximum number of days any year may have in the calendar given by the rscale property and the negative values of these numbers. For example, in the Gregorian calendar, valid values are 1 to 366 and -366 to -1. Negative values offset from the end of the year. The array MUST have at least one entry if included.

member.name: P:Goedel.Contacts.RecurrenceRule.byWeekNo
member.summary: These are the weeks of the year in which to repeat. Valid values are between 1 and the maximum number of weeks any year may have in the calendar given by the rscale property and the negative values of these numbers. For example, in the Gregorian calendar, valid values are 1 to 53 and -53 to -1. The array MUST have at least one entry if included.

member.name: P:Goedel.Contacts.RecurrenceRule.byHour
member.summary: These are the hours of the day in which to repeat. Valid values are 0 to 23. The array MUST have at least one entry if included. This is the BYHOUR part from iCalendar.

member.name: P:Goedel.Contacts.RecurrenceRule.byMinute
member.summary: These are the minutes of the hour in which to repeat. Valid values are 0 to 59. The array MUST have at least one entry if included.

member.name: P:Goedel.Contacts.RecurrenceRule.bySecond
member.summary: These are the seconds of the minute in which to repeat. Valid values are 0 to 60. The array MUST have at least one entry if included.

member.name: P:Goedel.Contacts.RecurrenceRule.bySetPosition
member.summary: These are the occurrences within the recurrence interval to include in the final results. Negative values offset from the end of the list of occurrences. The array MUST have at least one entry if included. This is the BYSETPOS part from iCalendar.

member.name: P:Goedel.Contacts.RecurrenceRule.count
member.summary: These are the number of occurrences at which to range-bound the recurrence. This MUST NOT be included if an until property is specified.

member.name: P:Goedel.Contacts.RecurrenceRule.until
member.summary: These are the date-time at which to finish recurring. The last occurrence is on or before this date-time. This MUST NOT be included if a count property is specified. Note that if not specified otherwise for a specific JSCalendar object, this date is to be interpreted in the time zone specified in the JSCalendar object's timeZone property.

member.name: P:Goedel.Contacts.NDay.Type
member.summary: This specifies the type of this object. This MUST be NDay.

member.name: P:Goedel.Contacts.NDay.day
member.summary: This is a day of the week on which to repeat; the allowed values are the same as for the firstDayOfWeek recurrenceRule property.

member.name: T:Goedel.Contacts.Alert
member.summary: An Alert object has the following properties:

member.name: P:Goedel.Contacts.Alert.Type
member.summary: This specifies the type of this object. This MUST be Alert.

member.name: P:Goedel.Contacts.Alert.Trigger
member.summary: This defines when to trigger the alert. New types may be defined in future documents.

member.name: P:Goedel.Contacts.Alert.acknowledged
member.summary: This records when an alert was last acknowledged. This is set when the user has dismissed the alert; other clients that sync this property SHOULD automatically dismiss or suppress duplicate alerts (alerts with the same alert id that triggered on or before this date-time).

member.name: P:Goedel.Contacts.Alert.relatedTo
member.summary: This relates this alert to other alerts in the same JSCalendar object. If the user wishes to snooze an alert, the application MUST create an alert to trigger after snoozing. This new snooze alert MUST set a parent relation to the identifier of the original alert.

member.name: P:Goedel.Contacts.Alert.action
member.summary: This describes how to alert the user.

member.name: P:Goedel.Contacts.Trigger.Type
member.summary: This specifies the type of this object. This MUST be OffsetTrigger, AbsoluteTrigger or UnknownTrigger .

member.name: P:Goedel.Contacts.Trigger.offset
member.summary: This defines the offset at which to trigger the alert relative to the time property defined in the relativeTo property of the alert. Negative durations signify alerts before the time property; positive durations signify alerts after the time property.

member.name: P:Goedel.Contacts.TimeZone.standard

member.name: P:Goedel.Contacts.TimeZone.daylight

member.name: T:Goedel.Contacts.TimeZoneRule

member.name: P:Goedel.Contacts.TimeZoneRule.Type
member.summary: This specifies the type of this object. This MUST be TimeZoneRule.

member.name: P:Goedel.Contacts.TimeZoneRule.Start
member.summary: This is the DTSTART property from iCalendar.

member.name: P:Goedel.Contacts.TimeZoneRule.OffsetFrom
member.summary: This is the TZOFFSETFROM property from iCalendar.

member.name: P:Goedel.Contacts.TimeZoneRule.OffsetTo
member.summary: This is the TZOFFSETTO property from iCalendar.

member.name: P:Goedel.Contacts.TimeZoneRule.RecurrenceRules
member.summary: This is the RRULE property mapped, as specified in Section 4.3.3. During recurrence rule evaluation, the until property value MUST be interpreted as a local time in the UTC time zone.

member.name: P:Goedel.Contacts.TimeZoneRule.RecurrenceOverrides

member.name: P:Goedel.Contacts.TimeZoneRule.Names

member.name: P:Goedel.Contacts.TimeZoneRule.Comments

mobile: this number is for a mobile phone. voice: this number supports calling by voice. text: this number supports text messages (SMS). video: this number supports video conferencing. main-number: this number is a main phone number such as the number of the front desk at a company, as opposed to a direct-dial number of an individual employee. textphone: this number is for a device for people with hearing or speech difficulties. fax: this number supports sending faxes. pager: this number is for a pager or beeper.
